critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/flow.py is 929 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting per-domain (projects.py, contacts.py, prospects.py, tickets.py, messages.py, roles.py, dashboard.py) under a /flow subpackage to keep blast radius small as Phase B grows.
POST /api/flow/projects/{id}/lose accepts `reason` as a QUERY parameter but client-side senders typically use JSON body. Should accept body via Pydantic model for consistency with other endpoints.

POST /api/flow/projects/{id}/transition payload merge does not validate keys — any client can write arbitrary fields onto the project document (e.g., overwrite stage_history). Whitelist allowed keys: package_url, pricing_data, proposal_url, contract_url, total_value, currency, brief_document_url, roadmap_document_url.

_generate_project_id uses uuid hex slice (6 chars) — collision probability is low but not zero; spec text says 'THCO-2026-XXXXXX' sequential format. Consider auto-increment per-year counter for true uniqueness + monotonic display IDs.
list_events parses both DD-MM and YYYY-MM-DD; silently skips malformed dates with bare `except`. Add explicit validation + warning log so bad data isn't invisible.

_send_stage_email blocks the transition response (awaited inline). On Resend outage the user-facing transition latency spikes. Move to background task (FastAPI BackgroundTasks or asyncio.create_task) so the API never waits on email I/O.
Role assignment endpoint does not check that the caller is admin/super_admin — any authenticated user can grant any flag to any user (privilege escalation). Add an admin guard.

Project transition has no guard rails — a user can jump from stage 1 to stage 12 directly with no warning. Consider validating that target_stage is contiguous (current_stage +/- 1) or requires admin override flag.
FlowTickets.jsx — TicketForm does not preselect a milestone, so engineer flow has to know project context cold. Minor UX.
Hardcoded 100-record / 500-record limits on list endpoints (list_contacts, list_prospects, list_tickets, list_messages) — no pagination; tenant with >500 contacts will see truncated data.
Audit log entries store `details` as arbitrary dict but include full notes — consider truncating to e.g. 1KB to avoid log-table bloat.
Frontend /flow/admin/roles has no permission gate (route is mounted for everyone). DashboardLayout.hasUnitAccess allows 'flow' for all users — anyone can land on /flow/admin/roles.
